correctness.rationale: For every k>=4, Johnson maximal cliques are stars or tops, triangles have unique support; reducing each higher clique by free faces leaves a 2D core. The hypersimplex 2-skeleton contains the same 1-skeleton and is simply connected; integral H2 is free. Signed augmented-chain Lefschetz sums over fixed vertices, oriented edges and unique higher-dimensional faces yield explicit ordinary S_(2k) cycle-index character; complementation exchanges star/top, so all fixed higher faces disappear, and parity-half analysis of cycles gives the stated two-coset character including trace(c)=-1. Independently constructed J(8,4) faces and checked signed Lefschetz for identity, complement, perfect matching, complemented perfect matching and transposition cases, all agreeing; these finite checks do not prove all-k.

evidence: Published Johnson sphere-wedge calculation applies to all J(n,k) at scale one but determines Betti, not all nonidentity character traces; weight-three character treats k=3, excluded here. Galetto et al full hypercube homology is not induced-weight-layer homology.
